name: Stream Event Matrix Gate Before Merge
hypothesis: Mandatory pre-merge stream-event matrix tests will reduce telemetry attribution regressions and unknown-provider rows.
change: For beads touching stream-event handling or provider usage paths, require matrix fixtures (turn/response/result, positive and negative attribution) before merge. Beads without matrix coverage on stream-event changes are blocked at review.
measurement: Unknown attribution rate (model='' iterations / total), telemetry-related regressions, and post-run completeness failures. Target: unknown attribution rate drops below 5% (from 9.5% baseline).
risk: Adds upfront test-writing time on stream-event beads specifically. Non-stream beads are unaffected.

previous_experiment.name: Periodic Full Validation Gate
previous_experiment.final_summary: 84 iterations since experiment start. All metrics regressed: failure rate 10.7% vs 9.3% baseline, avg cost/iteration $1.07 vs $0.63, avg duration 338s vs 264s. No evidence periodic gate caught regressions earlier. Data initially invisible due to worktree logs bug (gromit-r0x).
